decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - Before the relevant part of the works are commenced, the following shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority, and the works shall be carried out as approved:

(i) a sample of the replacement tiles.
(ii) details of the proportions and locations of the new roof tiles and details of the specification of the associated roofing 'felt' (if any).

Condition : 3 - A watching brief shall be kept by an appropriate structural ewngineer at the time of opening up in order to record the mechanics of the joist junctions, ascertain the condition of the joist seatings into the wall and to ensure that any requirements  for remedial actions are noted. Any such remedial actions shall be notified in writing to the Local Planning Authority to record and for potential variation prior to the relevant part of the works being carried out.

Condition : 4 - Work should be based on the principle of minimum replacement material. Photographs of opened upareas generally should be taken, with a selection forwarded to the Local Planning Authority.
description: Internal alterations on ground and first floor levels to existing house (Listed Building consent)
